# LLM session log - human-readable index

Every Claude Code session run in this repository is archived here: one folder per session (named by session id) holding the full transcript, the prompts as CSV and a readable `PROMPTS-AND-RESPONSES.md`. `sessions.csv` is the index of sessions and `prompt-log.csv` the real-time log of every prompt. See `llm-logs/README.md` for the design.
